name: Credential Dumping - LSASS via comsvcs.dll MiniDump
description: Detects rundll32.exe calling the MiniDump export of comsvcs.dll, a living-off-the-land way to dump LSASS memory and steal credentials (MITRE ATT&CK T1003.001). Matches Sysmon Event 1 (process creation) on WS01 where the rundll32.exe command line contains comsvcs and MiniDump. Normal Windows activity does not produce this command line. Limitation: an attempt blocked by Microsoft Defender before rundll32.exe starts creates no Sysmon event and will not trigger this rule; check the Defender logs for blocked attempts.
query: process where host.name == "ws01" and event.code == "1" and process.name == "rundll32.exe" and process.command_line : "*comsvcs*MiniDump*"
